[4] **DeepSeek-V4: a million-token context that agents can actually use** — Hugging Face Blog.
URL: https://huggingface.co/blog/deepseekv4
Tier 2 (HF community staff editorial). Extract: KV cache **percentages** vs V3.2 — V4-Pro at 1M uses 10% of V3.2's KV cache and 27% of V3.2's per-token FLOPs; V4-Flash uses 7% KV cache and 10% FLOPs vs V3.2. Layer distribution (61 layers, alternating CSA/HCA, sliding-window MTP). DSML token, XML tool format. DSEc Rust sandbox. Long-context retrieval cliff: 0.82+ MRCR through 256K, 0.59 at 1M. **Note:** the absolute KV cache figures (9.62 GiB / 83.9 GiB) are sourced from vLLM blog [17], not from this HF blog.

[5] **Models & Pricing** — DeepSeek API Docs.
URL: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
Tier 2. Extract: V4-Pro standard $1.74 input cache miss / $0.0145 cache hit / $3.48 output. V4-Pro 75% promo (until 2026-05-05 15:59 UTC) $0.435 / $0.003625 / $0.87. V4-Flash $0.14 / $0.0028 / $0.28. **Note on cache pricing:** the actual cache-hit:cache-miss ratio is 1:120 for V4-Pro and 1:50 for V4-Flash. The "1/10" figure widely quoted in launch coverage refers to cache-hit prices being reduced to 1/10 of their **prior** values [14] — not 1/10 of cache-miss. Max output 384K. No published rate limits.

## Inference framework / hardware (Tier 1-2)

[17] **DeepSeek V4 in vLLM** — vLLM Blog (April 24, 2026).
URL: https://vllm.ai/blog/deepseek-v4
Tier 2. Extract: V4-Pro on 8xB200 or 8xB300, V4-Flash on 4xB200 or 4xB300. Hopper + Blackwell support. vllm-ascend and vllm-mlu plugins. Three layer types (c4a, c128a, sliding-window). Inverse RoPE. Three kernel fusions, 5-6% latency reduction at low batch sizes. KV cache 9.62 GiB vs 83.9 GiB at 1M (8.7x reduction).

[18] **DeepSeek-V4 on Day 0: From Fast Inference to Verified RL** — LMSYS / SGLang Blog (April 25, 2026).
URL: https://www.lmsys.org/blog/2026-04-25-deepseek-v4/
Tier 2. Extract: V4-Flash on H200 TP=4 — 266 tok/s at 4K context, 240 tok/s at 900K (10% degradation across 225x scaling). V4-Pro on B200 TP=8 — 199 tok/s at 4K, 180 tok/s at 900K. ShadowRadix prefix caching. HiSparse offload (3x throughput on long contexts). Lightning TopK. Miles RL framework on 32 GB300 GPUs.

[19] **Build with DeepSeek V4 Using NVIDIA Blackwell and GPU-Accelerated Endpoints** — NVIDIA Developer Blog (April 24, 2026).
URL: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/build-with-deepseek-v4-using-nvidia-blackwell-and-gpu-accelerated-endpoints/
Tier 2. Extract: ">150 tokens/sec/user" V4-Pro on GB200 NVL72 (1K/1K ISL/OSL, MXFP4). Day-0 NIM availability. Build.nvidia.com developer endpoints. SGLang and vLLM serving recipes (multinode prefill/decode disagg up to 100+ GPUs). TensorRT-LLM NOT mentioned for V4 (gap).

[20] **Quantitative Analysis of Performance Drop in DeepSeek Model Quantization** — arxiv 2505.02390 (Zhao et al., May 5 2025, revised June 13 2025).
URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.02390
Tier 1 (preprint). Extract: 4-bit quantization "maintains little performance degradation versus FP8" on R1 and V3. DQ3_K_M dynamic 3-bit method outperforms standard Q3_K_M. NOT V4-specific — V4 ships in FP4 natively, so this paper establishes the V3-era pattern.
